_doc: Casting inputs of the mineworld-default pack (step-26 §7.4a item 5), read through casting.yaml. Per person: `fixed` (what the biography, an identity source or an operator ruling fixes, each with why), `allowed` (values the biography restricts an attribute to) and `fields` (the director's outfit and prompt-ready lines). Every attribute not fixed is drawn from the world's population profile. Never add a value here because of a surname. `fixed_members` are counted in a world's strata and distinctness table but never re-cast.
